name: @scout/gateway
description: Trusted OpenAI relay and read-only MCP surface for Scout.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run bundle:mcp && npm run bundle:runtime
scripts.bundle:mcp: npm run licenses && esbuild src/mcp-stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --legal-comments=external --minify-whitespace --metafile=../Plugins/scout/mcp/scout-mcp.meta.json --outfile=../Plugins/scout/mcp/scout-mcp.cjs && node ../Scripts/normalize-generated-bundle.mjs && node ../Scripts/generate-plugin-release-metadata.mjs && node ../Scripts/verify-plugin-release-metadata.mjs
